![Orientation day on campus.](orientation.jpg)


MDS moves fast. Orientation week was hectic, but super fun at the same time. I did ask myself *"What did I get myself into quite a few times"* but week one made me realise I was exactly where I'm supposed to be. Making friends was easy, Cohort 11 has some super cool people.
